newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Treasuries end up, modest rate hike priced in.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Treasuries end up, modest rate hike priced in.

text.p: The U.S. 30-year Treasury bond rallied on Friday, largely due to a relief trade on the U.S. August employment report, which -- while strong -- did not point to an aggressive rate hike, analysts said.
"There was nothing in the job report to indicate the Fed will have to do more than 25 points," one bond trader said.
The market has priced in a possible 25-basis-point hike in the 5.25-percent federal funds rate at the next meeting of the Federal Open Market Committee on September 24.
